sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("role" IN ('user', 'assistant')), "message_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('queued', 'pending_offline', 'processing', 'done', 'failed')), "language" TEXT NULL, "reply_to_message_id" TEXT NULL, "codec_version" INTEGER NULL, "budget_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX ix_chat_messages_order ON chat_messages (created_at, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_chat_messages_reply ON chat_messages (reply_to_message_id) WHERE reply_to_message_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weigh_ins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "measured_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("measured_at_utc" >= 0), "tz_offset_min" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("tz_offset_min" BETWEEN -720 AND 840), "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kg" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("kg" >= 0.0), "input_value" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("input_value" >= 0.0), "input_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("input_unit" IN ('kg', 'lb')), "note" TEXT NULL, "preferred_for_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("preferred_for_day" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX ix_weigh_ins_live ON weigh_ins (local_date, measured_at_utc) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_phases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "goal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "expression_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_kg" REAL NULL, "target_date" TEXT NULL, "kg_per_week" REAL NULL, "month_kg" REAL NULL, "month" TEXT NULL, "weight_input_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX ix_goal_phases_start ON goal_phases (start_date) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "target_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "rebalancing" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("rebalancing" IN (0, 1)), "base_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "manual" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("manual" IN (0, 1)), "acknowledged" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("acknowledged" IN (0, 1)), "basis_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "shift_mon" REAL NULL, "shift_tue" REAL NULL, "shift_wed" REAL NULL, "shift_thu" REAL NULL, "shift_fri" REAL NULL, "shift_sat" REAL NULL, "shift_sun" REAL NULL, "protein_value" REAL NULL, "protein_is_percent" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("protein_is_percent" IN (0, 1)), "fat_value" REAL NULL, "fat_is_percent" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("fat_is_percent" IN (0, 1)), "carbs_value" REAL NULL, "carbs_is_percent" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("carbs_is_percent" IN (0, 1)), "fiber_g" REAL NULL, "calories_protein_only" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("calories_protein_only" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX ix_target_settings_effective ON target_settings (effective_from) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "sex" TEXT NOT NULL, "birth_year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NOT NULL, "height_input_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "activity" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diary_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "food_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "food_version" TEXT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_ar" TEXT NULL, "input_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "input_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "amount_basis" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("amount_basis" IN ('g', 'ml')), "per100_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "per100_protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "per100_carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL, "per100_fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "per100_fiber_g" REAL NOT NULL, "per100_extras_json" TEXT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("kcal" >= 0.0), "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("protein_g" >= 0.0), "carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_g" >= 0.0), "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fat_g" >= 0.0), "fiber_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fiber_g" >= 0.0), "extras_json" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_estimate" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_estimate" IN (0, 1)), "estimate_range_json" TEXT NULL, "assumptions_json" TEXT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tz_offset_min" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("tz_offset_min" BETWEEN -720 AND 840), "slot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "dish_group_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX ix_diary_entries_live ON diary_entries (local_date, slot_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_diary_entries_group ON diary_entries (dish_group_id) WHERE dish_group_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dish_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX ix_dish_groups_live ON dish_groups (local_date) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meal_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "food_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "food_version" TEXT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_ar" TEXT NULL, "input_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "input_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "amount_basis" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("amount_basis" IN ('g', 'ml')), "per100_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "per100_protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "per100_carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL, "per100_fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "per100_fiber_g" REAL NOT NULL, "per100_extras_json" TEXT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("kcal" >= 0.0), "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("protein_g" >= 0.0), "carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_g" >= 0.0), "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fat_g" >= 0.0), "fiber_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fiber_g" >= 0.0), "extras_json" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_estimate" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_estimate" IN (0, 1)), "estimate_range_json" TEXT NULL, "assumptions_json" TEXT NULL, "saved_meal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX ix_saved_meal_items_meal ON saved_meal_items (saved_meal_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_marks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "incomplete" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("incomplete" IN (0, 1)), "not_fasting" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("not_fasting" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX ix_day_marks_date ON day_marks (local_date) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_diary_entries_food ON diary_entries (food_kind, food_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_saved_meal_items_food ON saved_meal_items (food_kind, food_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_slots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "default_key" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "window_start_min" INTEGER NULL, "window_end_min" INTEGER NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("mode" IN ('normal', 'ramadan')), "active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((window_start_min IS NULL) = (window_end_min IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "edited_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
